posts.title: How Fresh Are Your Blueberries? And What Would You Do If You Knew?
posts.description: Investigating the value of Sunrise 2027 for data-driven produce ordering - a POMDP model of perishable inventory, particle filtering, and what richer observation data actually buys you in profit.

posts.title: Signing git commits from emacs with magit and pinentry
posts.description: Why magit can hit “Inappropriate ioctl for device” with gpg-agent, and an elisp plus gpg-agent loopback approach that unlocks the key in Emacs before the git subprocess runs.

posts.title: Intro to LAMMPS
posts.description: A beginner-friendly tour of LAMMPS molecular dynamics: input scripts, data files, pair styles, and visualization with VMD — written to lower the learning curve I wish I'd had.
